title: LecturePatch
description: Request body of PATCH /lectures/{id}. Merge semantics, only the keys present are changed, null is never sent. An empty string clears course_code or notes. Setting status to cancelled cancels the lecture, no other status value is accepted. Finished and cancelled lectures cannot be patched.

course_code.description: Course code, an empty string clears it.

ends_at.description: End, ISO 8601 UTC, strictly after the resulting starts_at.

notes.description: Free text, an empty string clears it.

LecturePatchStatus.title: LecturePatchStatus
LecturePatchStatus.description: Status a client may set on a lecture.
